runs.text:
Lower the guard before you engage the blade. Keep the guard within the recommended clearance of the workpiece.

Check the tensioning wheel at regular intervals during a shift. Check the tensioning wheel even if you have not used the machine continuously. Tension can drift even when the machine is idle.

Inspect the lower blade guide for wear after you change the blade. If the replacement blade has the same width and pitch as the old blade, you may do a visual check only. Before you do a visual check, complete the tensioning procedure in this manual.

Do not wear loose clothing or jewelry near the machine. Tie back long hair before you operate the machine.

Wait until the blade has come to a complete stop before you leave the work area. The machine can stay hot for several minutes after use. Be careful of the hot surfaces.
